free_text: Biopsy is recommended due to the convergence of high-risk imaging (PI-RADS 5 lesion) and significant clinical trajectory, evidenced by a rapid PSA velocity of 1.85 ng/mL/yr and a high csPCa predicted probability of 0.8536296. Although the DRE was normal, the combination of a PI-RADS 5 finding and a rapidly ascending PSA strongly warrants tissue sampling to clarify the diagnosis and guide management.
